forbid: Clean, minimalist flat-vector icons without texture
Omitting the bottom center social media handle
Heavy grunge that severely obscures or eats away at the legibility of the typography
json.medium: Vintage etching, woodcut, and scratchboard-style illustration combined with typography.
json.shading: Achieved entirely through linework density, hatching, and cross-hatching, creating high-contrast shading without the use of smooth gradients or solid halftones.
json.texture: Highly gritty and textured organically through the dense linework, simulating real animal fur. Typography occasionally features subtle rough or stamped distressed edges.
evidence: IMAGE 1, 2, 7: Classic, strict black-and-white etching style designed for dark garments.
IMAGE 3, 8: Introduces a bright accent color (orange/yellow) to highlight accessories and specific emphasis text.
IMAGE 4, 5, 6, 9: Uses four-point sparkles scattered around the central subject to fill negative space.
IMAGE 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9: The social media handle is placed at the exact bottom center of every single design.
IMAGE 5, 6, 9: Demonstrates the colored variation of the linework, using rich rust browns and blacks to color the fur on light-colored garments.
IMAGE 3: Exception - uses a rough, dry-brush textured font for the secondary text, contrasting with the cleaner serifs usually favored.
IMAGE 7: Exception - features a split-panel composition to show two different states ('mood swings') rather than a single central hero subject.

linework.style: Dense, intricate hand-drawn hatching, contouring, and scratchy strokes to build highly realistic fur and hair textures.

subjects: Farm animals with humorous accessories (sunglasses, hats)

typography.vibe: Vintage Western slab serifs, retro bold display serifs, and woodtype styles, frequently paired with a softer flowing script or rough brush font for secondary phrasing.
typography.placement: Stacked centrally above and below the hero illustration, often curving around the top of the artwork, with a social handle locked to the bottom margin.

json.composition: Centrally aligned and vertically stacked. A central hero illustration (highland cow) sits perfectly in the middle, framed by arched or straight primary text above and straight secondary text below. The composition is always anchored by a small social media handle at the very bottom center.
signature_moves: Highly detailed, etching-style highland cow illustrations
Anchoring every design with a social media handle (@TheHappyHourFarm or @HighlandCowHappyHour) at the bottom center
Framing the central artwork symmetrically with bold text on top and bottom
Scattering four-point sparkles/stars in the negative space around the animal (especially on lighter garments)
